registeredButlers.browserRuntimePopulationDerivation: The 02:39 same-window server-body pair is 1099→1103. Browser execution adds one Orrery unmapped block in both versions. The baseline block lacks data-unknown-disclosure, so its marked-family count stays 1099; the corrected block carries the marker, so the complete three-surface marked-family count is 1104. The browser-level test enumerates every live element across all three surfaces by both selector and TreeWalker after scripts and compares computed color and symbol. The separate 02:42 live Chrome sweep confirms that Polaris and Trajectory gain no post-script family elements; it is not used for the paired byte or population totals because external work-item state changed between its two captures.
registeredButlers.earlierWindowReconciliation: The 02:12 UTC server-only pair reported 1098→1102; the fresh 02:39 UTC pair reports 1099→1103 because Trajectory has 326 badges on both heads rather than 325. That extra badge is a changed live work-item state between windows, not Orrery's runtime disclosure. Only the fresh pair is used for current baseline/head deltas.
registeredButlers.scopeLimit: Only one registered Butlers revision and its 02:39 same-window clean-tree response sizes were used for the paired figures. The new opening band repeats two existing Unknown claims, so tuple/disclosure counts rise without a new machine claim or source read. The baseline has an Orrery unmapped block, but it lacked a declared Unknown marker and treatment; the implementation adds exactly one runtime disclosure to the browser population.

Independently query those three selector families and compare counts, each element's computed color and ::before symbol to hard-coded Observed/Unknown treatments. Require every .orrery-block.unmapped node to carry a matching data-unknown-disclosure identity and visible Unknown text.
runtimeCorrection.laterFullBrowserCrossCheck: At 02:42 UTC, a separate direct/tailnet Chrome sweep over Home, Polaris, Trajectory and Orrery confirmed server=post-script family counts on Home, Polaris and Trajectory and a one-disclosure Orrery increment only on the corrected head. External work-item badges differed (baseline 325, head 324) and the Butlers working-tree metadata digest changed, so this later sweep is behavior-only and supplies no paired byte or total-population figure.
